_about: THE SHRINKING PENDING LIST for `machine-words.spec.ts` (D196, amended 2026-09-23 by `D284`: 'a new browser check reads the rendered text of every route'). KEY SHAPE: route -> word or path (lower-cased) -> the lane that owes the fix. There is NO wildcard route: the fixture is deterministic (`routeSweep.ts` registers every seed once and reads each screen only once it is loaded), so a word lands on the same route every run. A different list from `scripts/machine-words-allow.json` on purpose: that one keys by FILE, for the AST walk over JSX literals; this one keys by ROUTE, for rendered `innerText`, which carries no source file. `machine-words.spec.ts` fails on a hit not listed here AND on a listed entry that matches nothing (stale — delete it). `#/codes`'s 'Box 12index 1' was invisible to a `\b` word boundary, because innerText joins adjacent spans with no space; the matcher uses a LETTER boundary for that reason (`machineWords.ts:wordPattern`). `#/runs`'s 'emit' entry and `#/orders`'s `CardLocations` 'Pushed 0 Staged 0' pair (measured 2026-09-24) went stale by 2026-09-25 and were deleted: `RunPanel.tsx` now labels the step 'Price and send' rather than 'emit', and D274's card pane redesign (built 2026-09-24) replaced the walk's CardLocations block with a quieter line.
